dataStatus: Phase rules extracted into JSON for repeatable army onboarding

details: Once per phase in your hero phase: pick a friendly unit and Heal (D3) it.
enhancements.name: Locus of Fecundity

details: Passive summary: when a friendly model is slain, you can pick an enemy unit within 1 inch; on a 4+, it takes 1 mortal damage.
enhancements.name: Infested with Wonders

details: Once per battle in any combat phase: pick an enemy unit within 7 inches of your general and roll for each model in it; each 5+ deals 1 mortal damage.
enhancements.name: Pestilent Breath

details: Your movement phase summary: pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 14 inches of your general and return 1 slain model to it.
enhancements.name: Summoner of Plaguebearers

name: Maggotkin of Nurgle: Bleak Host

details: Spoilpox Scrivener ability. In your hero phase, pick the unit to receive Keep Counting, I'm Watching You before moving on.
hero.sourceLabel: Official Maggotkin of Nurgle faction pack PDF
hero.title: Keep Counting, I'm Watching You

details: Spoilpox Scrivener ranged attack. Resolve Disgusting Sneezes here if the unit is eligible to shoot.
shooting.sourceLabel: Official Maggotkin of Nurgle faction pack PDF
shooting.title: Disgusting Sneezes

details: Once per phase in your hero phase: while friendly units are wholly within 7 inches of your general, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of their melee weapons until end of phase.
regimentAbilities.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy

details: Passive summary: if your general is contesting an uncontested objective, roll a die; on a 3+, it becomes desecrated and your friendly units get Ward (4+) while contesting it until the opponent takes control.
regimentAbilities.name: Gardener of Nurgle

details: Your movement phase summary: spend any number of disease points; for each point spent, pick an enemy unit in combat with one of your units and roll a die, dealing 1 mortal damage on a 4+.
regimentAbilities.name: Nurgle's Embrace

summary: A grinding, disease-forward force built to absorb punishment and outlast key fights.
